info.name: Class 71 - Server-Sent Events (SSE)
info.description:
sse-demo on port 8080.

1. Run SseDemoApplication.
2. Open http://localhost:8080 in the browser: that is the CUSTOMER's screen, and it calls GET /events once and keeps the line open.
3. Send the RIDER requests below: the browser heading changes without a reload.

request.description:
The rider's app reports a new location. The server pushes it into the customer's open line.

Expect: `sent: 2 km away`, and the browser shows **2 km away**.

If you get `no customer is listening yet`, open http://localhost:8080 first.
Expect: the browser changes to **1 km away**.
Expect: the browser changes to **at your door**.

item.name: 4. Customer line (optional, open in the browser instead)

request.description:
This is the CUSTOMER's call. It never finishes: it keeps receiving messages.

Best seen in the browser (http://localhost:8080) or with `curl -N http://localhost:8080/events`. Postman shows the stream too, but while it is open, Postman can't send other requests from the same tab.

Note: opening this replaces the browser's line (the demo keeps only one customer).
